title: Tech Note: OCI Mapper Debug 2004-1
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a debug-logging companion component for the OCI Mapper, a hand-rolled 4D-language wrapper that emulated the old 4D Oracle plug-in's high-level commands on top of the lower-level 4D for OCI plug-in. The entire OCI Mapper ecosystem (4D Oracle, 4D for OCI, OCI Mapper) predates 4D's native SQL engine (introduced in v11, 2007) and modern ORDA-based data access, so this is now of historical/archival interest only for developers maintaining decades-old Oracle-connected 4D databases. The debugging technique itself (process-based text logging with stack-level indentation) is a generic, still-understandable pattern, but the specific commands and component are long obsolete.
related_updates: 4D introduced its own integrated SQL engine in 4D v11 (2007), reducing reliance on plug-in-based external database bridges like 4D for OCI
The 4D Oracle and 4D for OCI plug-ins and the community OCI Mapper component are no longer part of current 4D product offerings
